description: Look up CMS High-Level Trigger paths by exact name (HLT_IsoMu24) or prefix pattern (HLT_IsoMu*), optionally for one data-taking year. Paths outside the HLT_ family, such as AlCa_EcalPi0, DST_ and DQM_ paths, output modules and HLTriggerFinalPath, are found by their own names, in the case given. Each match is a per-year path record parsed into the primary datasets its title names, the first and last run the path was seen online, per-version run ranges, the L1 seed, and links to the HLT menu records. Covers CMS open data from 2011-2016. Prescale tables are not published.

page.description: Page number, from 1. page × limit may not exceed 10,000.

path.description: Trigger path name (HLT_IsoMu24, AlCa_EcalPi0) or prefix with one trailing wildcard (HLT_IsoMu*): a letter or digit, then letters, digits and underscores. Trimmed. A path starting HLT_ in any case is searched as given, with the prefix case fixed, and matches path names in any case. Any other path is matched against record path names in the case given, the whole name or, with a trailing *, its start (AlCa_EcalPi0, AlCa_*), and is also searched with HLT_ prepended (IsoMu24 finds HLT_IsoMu24, 60Jet10 finds HLT_60Jet10). A trailing version suffix (_v3 or _v*) is dropped, since records list versions as V<n>.

year.description: Data-taking year, such as 2012. Trigger records cover 2011-2016.

name: cern_opendata_search_trigger_paths

cap.description: The page size (limit) applied to this call.

effectiveQuery.description: The query sent, after normalization (version suffix dropped): an HLT_ path as given; any other path as title clauses matching it as a record path name, OR HLT_ plus the path.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `page_window_exceeded`: page × limit exceeds 10,000, the deepest match the portal pages to. `rate_limited`: The portal's 60-a-minute budget is spent: it answered 429, or the request could not start within the call's deadline. data.retryAfter is set. `upstream_unreadable`: The portal answered with a body the server could not read: not JSON, missing the expected envelope, or over the byte ceiling (then data.retryable is false). Also raised when a search answers 404. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when the next page holds matches and lies within the first 10,000. False on the last reachable page even when more matches exist; truncated and notice say so.

notice.description: Guidance for the next call: how to page on, why nothing matched and what to change, or a caveat about the results.

shown.description: Number of items returned on this page.

totalCount.description: Trigger path records matching the path (and year).

triggers.description: Matching trigger path records on this page.

items.description: One trigger path record (one path in one data-taking year).

abstract_html.description: The record abstract as the portal sent it (HTML), the source of every parsed field.

dataset.description: Primary dataset named in the title, such as SingleMu, when the title names exactly one; absent when it names several (see datasets).

datasets.description: Every primary dataset the title names, in order, such as ["DoubleMu", "DoubleMuParked"]; absent when it names none.

first_seen.description: First run the path was seen online.

menu.description: HLT menu name as the record states it, such as /cdaq/physics/Run2011/5e32/v4.2/HLT/V2.

menu_recid.description: Recid of the HLT menu record (Supplementaries::Configuration HLT), when linked; cern_opendata_get_records reads it.

last_seen.description: Last run the path was seen online.

menu.description: HLT menu name as the record states it, such as /cdaq/physics/Run2011/5e32/v4.2/HLT/V2.

menu_recid.description: Recid of the HLT menu record (Supplementaries::Configuration HLT), when linked; cern_opendata_get_records reads it.

parsed.description: False when the first-seen line or every version line could not be parsed; read abstract_html then.

path.description: Path name from the record title, such as HLT_IsoMu24.

portal_url.description: The record page on the portal.

recid.description: Recid of the trigger path record.

trigger_list_recid.description: Recid of the year's full CMS trigger-list record, when linked; cern_opendata_get_records reads it.

versions.description: Per-version run ranges, as parsed from the record; empty when none parsed.

items.description: One path version and its run range.

l1_seed.description: Level-1 seed as the record states it, such as L1_SingleMu12.

run_first.description: First run of this version, inclusive.

run_last.description: Last run of this version, inclusive.

version.description: n of V<n>, the path version (the _v<n> suffix of the CMSSW path name).

truncated.description: True when more results remain past this page; notice says how to reach them.

title: Search CMS Trigger Paths
